result.title: PANDA: Prior-guided Attentional Dual-path Architecture
result.summary: Hypergraph Neural Networks (HNNs), designed to model higher-order relations beyond pairwise interactions, typically rely either on fixed structural weights or on normalised attention. Fixed weights can propagate misleading information in heterophilic settings, while normalisation makes attention coefficients competitive, in the sense that, in a message-passing framework, increasing the weight of one sender must reduce the weight of others in the same aggregation set. Our main contribution is the introduction of PANDA (Prior-guided AttentioNal Dual-path Architecture), a plug-in for two-stage message passing HNNs applicable to both undirected and directed settings. The main path interpolates between learned receiver-normalised attention and structural incidence priors, while a non-competitive (not normalised) auxiliary path lets each sender contribute its own transformed information. We also show that, with fixed structural coefficients, PANDA recovers a certain complex-valued convolution operator adopted in previous works. Across four HNNs spanning spatial and spectral methods in both directed and undirected settings, plugging PANDA in yields an average improvement of 5.18 percentage points across eight real-world benchmark datasets. The code is available at https://github.com/jainris/panda.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 PANDA，一个用于两阶段消息传递超图神经网络的插件式双路架构：主路在学习到的接收端归一化注意力与结构关联先验之间插值，辅助路不做归一化，使每个发送者可独立贡献其变换后的信息，并在 4 种超图网络、8 个基准上报告平均提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「归一化注意力导致竞争性抑制、另设非竞争辅助路保留各来源贡献」的思路，可能可供核查 latent reasoning 中视觉证据聚合与信息坍缩问题，但属跨领域方法线索，需人工判断可迁移性。
